expo-feature.description: Use when adding a new screen, route, tab, or self-contained feature to this Expo Router app. Handles route files, layout registration, typed routes, ui.tsx primitives, themed styles, and the useServer data flow.

api-contract.description: Use when the backend HTTP surface changes, or when a send/tracking feature is added, a response shape is consumed in a screen, or types.ts and api.ts need to be reconciled with be-docs/API.md. Also use for adding or changing a backend endpoint call.

rn-reviewer.description: Read-only review of React Native / React 19 / React Compiler correctness in this repo: hook deps, effect cleanup, stale closures, list virtualization, re-render cost, async races, safe-area and keyboard handling, accessibility, and cross-platform breakage.

debug-network.description: Use when the app cannot reach the backend, sends fail, jobs never leave the queue, or emails do not appear: base-URL resolution per platform, emulator host addresses, Redis/BullMQ 503, sync vs queue mode, Mailpit, and ApiError triage.

verify-changes.description: Run the repo's verification gate (npx tsc --noEmit, npx expo lint) and report only real, reproducible failures with file:line. Use before declaring any change complete.

ui.description: Use when building or extending visual components in this app: compose from src/components/ui.tsx primitives, consume useTheme tokens and the space/radius scales, use flex gap instead of margins, and keep light/dark parity.

ui-ux.description: Read-only UX and accessibility audit of screens: empty/error/loading states, touch targets, contrast in both color schemes, dynamic type, screen-reader labels, destructive-action confirmation, and consistency with the rest of the app.
